items.title: 70,000+ MongoDB Servers Vulnerable to MongoBleed Exploit – PoC Released
items.description: A critical vulnerability in MongoDB Server is putting tens of thousands of databases worldwide at risk. Dubbed MongoBleed and tracked as CVE-2025-14847, this high-severity flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to remotely extract sensitive data from server memory without credentials. items.title: Critical 0-Day RCE Vulnerability in Networking Devices Exposes 70,000+ Hosts
items.description: A critical zero-day vulnerability has been discovered in XSpeeder’s SXZOS firmware, affecting tens of thousands of SD-WAN appliances, edge routers, and smart TV controllers deployed globally. The vulnerability, designated PWN-25-01, enables unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE) with root-level privileges through a single HTTP GET request. items.title: Korean Air Data Compromised in Oracle EBS Hack
items.description: Roughly 30,000 Korean Air employees had their data stolen by hackers in a breach at former subsidiary KC&D. The post Korean Air Data Compromised in Oracle EBS Hack appeared first on SecurityWeek.
